maintenance.title: MANUAL MAINTENANCE
maintenance.cleanup.description: Frees up disk space by removing leftovers: temporary files, logs, caches, the Recycle Bin, restore points and old Windows files.
cleanup.title: FREE UP SPACE
cleanup.temp_files.description:
Removes temporary files that Windows and programs leave behind. Anything modified in the last {cleanup_age} h is kept, and files in use are skipped. Windows rebuilds Prefetch, so the first launch of each program may be slightly slower.

- User · %TEMP% folder
- Windows · C:\Windows\Temp
- Startup · Prefetch (.pf files)
cleanup.hidden_junk.description:
Removes hidden files that Windows builds up in the background. Folders with pictures may open slower once, icons may redraw while they are rebuilt, and past crash reports are lost.

- Explorer · thumbnail and icon caches
- Reports · Windows error reports (WER)
- Dumps · crash, memory and kernel dumps
cleanup.components.description:
Frees space from the Windows component store and from Windows Defender. It takes minutes, cannot be cancelled once started and may ask for a restart. You can still uninstall updates, and the gain is not estimated.

- Updates · components left by old updates (WinSxS)
- Defender · logs and scan cache (quarantine is kept)
cleanup.windows_old.description:
Deletes the previous Windows installation with the Windows Disk Cleanup. It can free many GB, but you can no longer go back to the previous version of Windows. It asks for confirmation first and cannot be cancelled once started. Only available with Safe mode OFF.

- Installation · C:\Windows.old
cleanup.windows_old.confirm: This permanently deletes the previous Windows installation (C:\Windows.old). You will no longer be able to go back to the previous version of Windows, and this cannot be undone. Once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
cleanup.all.description: Runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other, and shows the result of each. It always asks for confirmation, even with Safe mode ON (which skips the actions it blocks). Cannot be cancelled once started and can take several minutes. All the consequences above apply.
cleanup.all.confirm:
This runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other.
Once it starts it CANNOT be cancelled, and it can take several minutes.
The Recycle Bin is emptied for good: deleted items cannot be restored.
With Safe mode OFF, the restore points are deleted too and Windows.old as well: you can no longer go back with a restore point or to the previous version of Windows.
Parts of it need administrator.
cleanup.recycle_bin.description:
Permanently empties the Recycle Bin of every fixed drive. Deleted items cannot be restored afterwards.

- Drives · C:\, D:\ and any other fixed drive
components.step: Cleaning the Windows component store (this can take several minutes)
windows_old.step: Deleting Windows.old (this can take several minutes)

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.safe_mode.description:
When ON, blocks the actions that cannot be undone and put the system at risk. Turn it OFF to run them. ON is recommended. Saved between sessions.

- Blocked · Windows.old, restore points, hibernation
confirm.title: ARE YOU SURE?
confirm.skipped: Skipped, because Safe mode is ON:
notice.settings_not_saved: Could not save the setting. It applies until Caduceus closes.
maintenance.tweaks.description: Changes Windows settings that are not disk cleanups, such as turning off hibernation. Nothing runs unless you choose it.
cleanup.windows_logs.description:
Removes Windows maintenance and setup logs. Logs from the last {log_age} h are kept, so there is still something to diagnose problems with.

- Servicing · CBS, DISM, Windows Update logs
- Setup · Panther and setupapi logs
cleanup.system_caches.description:
Removes cached Windows Update downloads, delivery files, shaders and other Windows caches. Games may stutter briefly while shaders are rebuilt, and a pending update is downloaded again.

- Updates · Windows Update, Delivery Optimization
- Graphics · DirectX, NVIDIA, AMD shader caches
- Windows · Microsoft Store, Windows Search, etc.
cleanup.browser_caches.description:
Removes the caches of your web browsers, from every profile. Cookies, passwords, history and extensions are never touched. Pages load slower the first time, and web apps that work offline may need to download their data again. Close the browsers first to free more.

- Chromium · Chrome, Edge, Brave, etc.
- Opera · Opera, Opera GX
- Firefox · every profile
- Contents · pages, code, shaders, etc.
cleanup.app_caches.description:
Removes the caches of apps you use every day. Accounts, messages, notes, settings and downloaded songs are never touched, and apps that are not installed are ignored. Apps open slower the first time.

- Chat · Discord, Slack, Teams, etc.
- Work · Notion, Obsidian, Figma
- Dev · VS Code, Cursor, Postman
- Media · Spotify
- Games · Steam, Epic Games Launcher
cleanup.developer_caches.description:
Removes the package caches of your development tools. Your projects, node_modules and .nuget\packages are not touched. Packages are downloaded again on the next build or install, which fails without network.

- JavaScript · npm
- Python · pip, uv, Poetry
- .NET · NuGet, Visual Studio
- Java · Gradle
- Systems · Cargo, Go, Dart
cleanup.restore_points.description:
Deletes all restore points and Shadow Copies of the system drive. It can free many GB, but you can no longer go back with a restore point or recover earlier versions of files. It asks for confirmation first and cannot be cancelled once started. Only available with Safe mode OFF.

- Restore · system restore points
- Files · Shadow Copies (previous versions)
cleanup.restore_points.confirm: This permanently deletes ALL the restore points and Shadow Copies of the system drive. You will no longer be able to restore Windows to an earlier point or recover earlier versions of files, and this cannot be undone. Once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
tweaks.title: SYSTEM TWEAKS
tweaks.hibernation.description:
Turns off hibernation to free the space it reserves. This is a system setting, not a disk cleanup. It asks for confirmation first. Only available with Safe mode OFF.

- Hibernation · hiberfil.sys (about 40% of RAM)
- Startup · Fast Startup is turned off too
tweaks.hibernation.confirm: This turns off hibernation and deletes C:\hiberfil.sys. Fast Startup is turned off too, so Windows may start more slowly, and you can no longer hibernate. To undo it, run powercfg /hibernate on as administrator.
